Pipeline stage: add items to a bank

Source: R/pipeline-bank.R
bank_items.Rd

Adds the items of a calibrated pipeline to an item bank, on the bank's scale. With no bank, a new bank is started from the pipeline. With an existing bank, the pipeline should first be linked to it with link_to_bank() so that the new items are on the same scale; items already in the bank (the anchors) keep their bank parameters unless update_anchors = TRUE.

Usage

bank_items(p, bank = NULL, name = "Item bank", update_anchors = FALSE)

Arguments

p

a calibrated pipeline from calibrate().

bank

optional existing bank from mv_bank().

name

name for a new bank.

update_anchors

logical; replace the bank parameters of items that are already in the bank with the new estimates.

Value

The pipeline with the bank in p$bank. Get it with p$bank and save it with saveRDS().

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- add_responses(mv_pipeline("Form A"), certexam, items = 3:34,
                   key = certexam_key)
p <- calibrate(drop_items(p, "Q14"), model = "2PL")
p <- bank_items(p, name = "Certification bank")
p$bank
#> <mv_bank> Certification bank: 31 items (31 active)
#> Item types: 2PL 31 
#> Location (b) from -2.37 to 3.05; median discrimination 0.90
#> Sources: Form A 
# }
